title: The Self/Environmental Cleanliness Metaphor of Moral Concept: An event-related potential study
descriptions: The data came from two experiments. Because EEG data are involved, each experiment contains both behavioural and EEG data. The four conditions mentioned are: 1= clean sentences and moral vocabulary; 2= Clean sentences and non-words; 3=Neutral sentences and moral vocabulary; 4=Neutral sentences and non-words.
